Legal Services

Strategic Legal Servicesfor Serious Matters

Zaheer & Zaheer Advocates provides legal services to individuals, companies, employers, institutions and overseas Pakistanis across litigation, advisory and regulatory practice areas.

Labour & Industrial Relations

Advisory and litigation support for employers, industrial establishments, unions, disciplinary matters, retrenchment, compliance and labour disputes.

Corporate & Commercial Advisory

Legal advisory for companies, contracts, commercial disputes, regulatory issues, board matters and institutional legal strategy.

Civil Litigation

Representation in civil suits, injunctions, declarations, damages, recovery matters and property-related disputes.

Constitutional Petitions

Strategic constitutional litigation before High Courts involving public authorities, statutory bodies and regulatory action.

Family Litigation

Legal representation in family suits, guardianship matters, maintenance, dissolution, dowry articles and related proceedings.

Real Estate & Property Disputes

Legal services for property transactions, specific performance, title disputes, possession, transfer issues and Bahria Town Karachi matters.

Overseas Pakistani Legal Services

Representation and advisory for overseas Pakistanis in property, family, inheritance, civil and litigation matters in Pakistan.

Regulatory & Tribunal Proceedings

Representation before statutory authorities, labour forums, tribunals, commissions and regulatory bodies.

Legal Notices & Documentation

Drafting of legal notices, replies, agreements, pleadings, affidavits, opinions and court-ready legal documentation.
